description: We are a passionate team excited about space, technology, and innovation. We love solving real-world problems, exploring new ideas, and building impactful solutions. We bring creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. We're looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in AI/ML, Python, web development, data science, UI/UX, and space research. Most importantly, we value curiosity, dedication, and collaboration. Let's innovate and build something extraordinary!
